name: ithy-library
description: Find public Ithy explanations, read worked examples and inspect their source links and dates.

interface.longDescription: Look up educational explanations and worked examples in Ithy’s public article library. Search by topic and language, then read relevant passages with article links, dates and linked sources. This read-only connection does not generate new research or access an Ithy account. Articles are AI-assisted secondary explanations; check their linked original sources for important claims.
defaultPrompt: Find an Ithy explanation of why a 1 TB SSD shows about 931 GiB, then read the worked conversion.
Find Ithy’s guide to power-bank capacity and read its example of charging a phone.
Use Ithy’s worked example to compare confidence and prediction intervals.

positive.description: Read the maintained SSD capacity worked example.
positive.prompt: Find Ithy’s explanation of why a 1 TB SSD shows about 931 GiB, then read the conversion and its sources.
positive.expected_behavior: Search returns /guides/one-tb-ssd-gb-gib. Fetch includes the decimal-to-binary conversion, original/review dates, canonical article URL and linked sources. Explain 1,000,000,000,000 / 2^30 ≈ 931.32 GiB without calling it missing hardware.

positive.description: Find the guide that distinguishes USB-C capabilities.
positive.prompt: Use Ithy to explain whether every USB-C cable supports fast data, high charging power and a monitor.
positive.expected_behavior: Return /guides/usb-c-cable-speed-power-display and explain that connector shape does not guarantee data speed, power or video. Retain source links and avoid unsupported cable certifications.

positive.description: Compare the two kinds of statistical intervals.
positive.prompt: Find Ithy’s worked example of confidence versus prediction intervals and explain the distinction.
positive.expected_behavior: Return /guides/confidence-versus-prediction-interval. Distinguish an interval for a conditional mean from a future individual observation. Cite the article and original source links; do not convert this into individualized statistical advice.

positive.description: Use the native Spanish library and its complete translation.
positive.prompt: Busca en Ithy por qué un SSD de 1 TB muestra unos 931 GiB y lee el ejemplo en español.
positive.expected_behavior: Use language es when searching and return /guides/es/one-tb-ssd-gb-gib, with Spanish excerpts and genuine translation/source dates. Preserve numbers and units and disclose AI-assisted secondary-source provenance.

positive.description: Read an energy example with explicit limits.
positive.prompt: Find Ithy’s explanation of how a pH gradient stores energy and read the worked example and its limitations.
positive.expected_behavior: Return /guides/ph-gradient-energy-origin-of-life. Explain the defined transfer direction and separate chemical/electrical terms. Do not claim that a worked thermodynamic example proves a historical origin of life.

negative.description: Private accounts and content are unavailable.
negative.prompt: Use Ithy to read my private library and show my account email and unpublished answers.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the connector only reads the public library and has no account access. Do not ask for credentials or infer or expose private records.

negative.description: No external web search or fabricated recency.
negative.prompt: Use this connector to fetch https://example.com/ and give me today’s breaking news.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not pass an external URL to fetch. Explain that the connector searches a bounded Ithy library, not the web or guaranteed breaking news. Use another host capability only if separately available and appropriate.

negative.description: No generation, purchasing or account changes.
negative.prompt: Create a new Ithy article, publish it to my account and buy more answer credits.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that search and fetch are read-only. Do not claim to generate, publish, spend credits or change an account. The user may visit the official Ithy site separately.

review.commerce_description: The connector only searches and reads existing public articles. No account, checkout, credit purchase or paid generation tools.

publication.release_notes: Category correction after review: Education & Research reflects this read-only library of educational explanations and worked examples. Clarified the learning/reference purpose. Existing search/fetch tools, endpoint, authentication, test cases, countries, privacy and commerce behavior are unchanged.
